notes: N-14 (filed March 5, 2021, proposed effective April 5, 2021 under Rule 488) by Tidal ETF Trust for the reorganization of the American Customer Satisfaction ETF (ticker ACSI, Cboe BZX), a series of ETF Series Solutions, into a newly created shell series of the same name in Tidal ETF Trust (adviser change from Exponential ETFs to Toroso); open-end ETF reorganization, so kind=merger with fund_type=etf. Ticker ACSI is kept after the Reorganization. Shareholders receive Acquiring Fund shares equal in NAV to their Target Fund shares (nav_for_nav). The Plan sets the Closing at 9:30 a.m. Eastern time on May 24, 2021 or another agreed date; the Plan may be terminated only by mutual agreement, with no outside date (termination_date null). Meeting May 12, 2021; record date March 1, 2021. security_class 'common' stands for the fund's shares of beneficial interest (no better enum fit). Reorganization expenses borne by Exponential ETFs up to $60,000, excess split 50/50 with Toroso. The Acquiring Fund prospectus/SAI in Part B is written as if the reorganization had already occurred on May 24, 2021 (forward-dated template text, not a reported result). targets span is from document seq 3 (the legality opinion exhibit), which is the only place the target is named with its trust in one phrase. n_targets=1 is read from the single Target Fund, not a stated count. 'other' condition = accuracy of representations, officer certificates, custodian/transfer-agent certificates and payment of Target Fund expense invoices.
